specs.title: the Dead Band refuses drones, playbooks and relay chains
CONTROL — Relay Valley, same tile, keeps all three
the front keeps its schedule, mutes only what it covers, and never damages it
a playbook refuses under the wall and works the moment it passes
a plain boot fields the front and its objective without ?debug
the deadline latch arms only on a front that can be discharged
the contract wires the low-orbit consumer with its declared geography
a lob that hits nothing returns once after 12s, then is gone
a lob that hits something is spent, and never returns
handholds are a soft constraint: off-route thrust halves, and is never a wall
the debris bands slow the suit and chip it
the board refuses the Seed Run until Dome Basin is secured — the reach, measured
planting at the stake spends the guard, lands at run end, and is born as a green next run
